name: Hierarchical Ray Marching
definition: A hierarchical ray marching technique that switches between octree levels and voxel levels. It starts at the finest level (voxels, level -1) or a coarse octree level, and adjusts the level up or down based on hit/miss status to optimize traversal.
summary: Hierarchical Ray Marching is a sparse voxel traversal technique that dynamically adjusts traversal granularity between octree and voxel levels to optimize ray-marching performance.
